senses.gloss: to provide with a bosom or border. Part. pass. חָפוּת.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 3:2">Shek. III, 2</cite> <he>אין התורם … בפרגוד ח׳</he> he who takes the money out of the Temple cell must not enter with a bordered cloak (in order not to create suspicion; Ms. M. <he>האפות</he>, Mish. Pes. <he>הֶחָפוּת</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.).—Pl. <he>חֲפוּתִין</he>. Midr. Sam. ch. XXI <he>נמצאו ח׳ וכ׳</he> the garments were found (to fit David) forming a bosom, not dragging along &c.; (<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26">Lev. R. s. 26</cite>, a. e. <he>עשויין לו</he> as if made for him).
<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 7:18">Tosef. Ber. VII, 18</cite> <he>לחַפּוֹת לו חלוק והוא לא הי׳ וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>הפך</he>) to form the bosom of his shirt, while he never had &c.
